I recently worked with Brooklyn Digital Foundry to redesign my company's website and digital materials, and unfortunately, it was a complete disaster. I would not recommend this agency to anyone.

From the start, communication was poor and the project was delayed multiple times without explanation. When we finally received the designs, it was evident that they did not use best practices in their digital designs resulting in extremely poor user experience. The design was difficult to navigate, confusing and unintuitive, making it impossible for our customers to find the information they needed.

When we brought up our concerns, they were dismissive and unprofessional, refusing to make any changes or offer any solutions. It was clear that they were not interested in delivering a quality product or meeting our needs as a client.

Overall, my experience with Brooklyn Digital Foundry was extremely disappointing and I would not recommend them to anyone. Save yourself the time and money and find a more competent agency to work with.

Abbey is everything my small business has been looking for. There is so much noise out there, so many ways to spend your valuable money on marketing, and all the while not knowing exactly what you are spending the money on. I just wanted what money I could afford, to be spent as effectively as possible, for the most return. Having a small business doesn't always mean you can cast a wide net, that would be a luxury, so targeting as carefully as you can is so very important.
Besides being a delight to work with, Abbey was able to "get" exactly what I was trying to achieve and tailor a package just for my needs, at an affordable price. At the same time she was able to walk me through what steps we were taking, providing education, so I could take some of the new platforms and run with it myself, which was one of my requests.
I cannot recommend her enough, she is a vital tool and dearest personality, for any small business looking to grow their social media marketing, and drive sales online.

text.text:
We shared an office space with these "web designers" and submitted our highly functional and specific needs to them, and they seemed to understand what we need.  So when they hit us with a $15,000 to $20,000 price we trusted them and agreed.  BIG mistake.  Clearly, they have no idea how to build a website, although they will tell you whatever you want to hear to get your money.  AND you better have a lot of it, because when our website was done, virtually none of our needed functions was completed and the site was seriously flawed.  They couldn't produce a calendar that updates automatically with the date for all this money.  I built a personal site on Square Space and added the calendar in 5 seconds.   Total cost for my site: $97.   $97 can get you a calendar that $20,000 couldn't.

We had three separate web developers look into the site, all people I know and trust, and all three independently of each other came up with the exact same appraisal...no more than $3000.  All the functions we need, Antarctic said couldn't be included in the initial price and would now cost more than $20,000 to $30,000 with no end in site.  On top of that we received the 'non-profit discount" as friends.  They claimed that the site had taken 400 hours to do (397 is a better fake number they came up with) but they would be nice and only bill us for 200 hours.  400 hours would come out to a $65,000 site.  Again, they are saying the value of this site to be $65,000, our appraisals were all $3,000 tops.  400 hours, and it wasn't even close to being finished.

When we refused payment they sued my company.  They are also masters of putting together contracts that favor them and leave you helpless.  In a nutshell, these aren't some of the shadiest people in NYC, they are some of the shadiest people on the whole planet.  Do yourself a favor, and find yourself a real web designer who's has a conscience.

We are a law firm based in New York, and we brought in 2Marketing about three months ago to help us improve our visibility in AI-driven search platforms like Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Gemini, and other emerging search experiences. The results so far have honestly been impressive.

In a very short period of time, they managed to get our firm showing up in AI-generated answers for relevant legal searches, while also strengthening our overall SEO foundation. We are already seeing better quality leads and stronger brand recognition, especially from clients who mention finding us through AI search results rather than traditional listings.

What really sets 2Marketing apart is their deep understanding of AI SEO and how search is evolving. This is not generic SEO work. Their strategy is forward-thinking, data-driven, and clearly built for where search is heading. Communication has been excellent throughout the process, and they are always transparent about progress and next steps.

If you are a law firm in New York looking to stay ahead of the curve and dominate AI search visibility, I highly recommend 2Marketing. What they achieved in just three months has exceeded our expectations, and we are excited to keep working with them.
